custody_model: Non-custodial smart-contract lending protocol. First-party documentation describes user-supplied assets being deposited into protocol markets and made available to borrowers, with protected-collateral options for isolated deposits.
yield_source: Interest paid by borrowers to suppliers in Kinza lending markets, subject to protocol utilization and market parameters.
risk_notes: As of 2026-08-23 new supply and borrowing are restricted while repay and withdraw remain open. This record does not infer insolvency, loss, or a withdrawal freeze.
